description: This file defines the public API for cache controller drivers in the Zephyr project, including functions for enabling, disabling, flushing, invalidating, and querying cache lines for data and instruction caches.

methods.name: cache_data_flush_and_invd_all
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates the entire data cache.

methods.name: cache_data_flush_range
methods.description: Flushes a specific address range in the data cache.

methods.name: cache_data_invd_range
methods.description: Invalidates a specific address range in the data cache.

methods.name: cache_data_flush_and_invd_range
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates a specific address range in the data cache.

methods.name: cache_instr_flush_and_invd_all
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates the entire instruction cache.

methods.name: cache_instr_flush_range
methods.description: Flushes a specific address range in the instruction cache.

methods.name: cache_instr_invd_range
methods.description: Invalidates a specific address range in the instruction cache.

methods.name: cache_instr_flush_and_invd_range
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates a specific address range in the instruction cache.

methods.name: cache_data_line_size_get
methods.description: Returns the size of the data cache line, or 0 if not enabled.

methods.name: cache_instr_line_size_get
methods.description: Returns the size of the instruction cache line, or 0 if not enabled.
